ModMetaData.name: ESCP - Spriggan
ModMetaData.description: The Elder Scrolls Collaboration Project Presents: Spriggans. Tree spirits that guard Tamriel's forests, heal themselves with sap and turn the local wildlife against anyone who harms their groves. They are rarely seen in the wild, but cut down enough of their forest and they come looking for whoever did it.
